hypotheses.note: [ChartedSpace (S n) V] [HasGroupoid V (projGroupoid n)] (README conventions); the bare IsDivisible forms for an arbitrary simply connected covering (isDivisible_of_isCoveringMap_proj) do not use HasGroupoid
[T2Space V]; used to separate two distinct fibres in the proper-discontinuity step (exists_nhds_eq_of_comp_eq) and for local compactness of V (compact set meeting every fibre)

not assumed; UniversalCover V v₀ is then the universal cover of the path component of v₀ and is still divisible (the quotient is compact because the range of a covering is closed, isClosed_range_of_isCoveringMap)

UniversalCover V v₀ (ported construction) with the pulled-back charts, the unique structure making the projection a morphism (existsUnique_pullback); the statement also asserts it is a covering, simply connected, locally projective and that the projection is a projective morphism; every simply connected covering (homeomorphic to it over V, exists_homeomorph_of_simplyConnected) is divisible as well (isDivisible_of_isCoveringMap_proj)

the strict library's IsDivisible (subgroup of GXAut, Mathlib ProperlyDiscontinuousSMul per DEC-120, IsCancelSMul, CompactSpace of the orbit quotient), witnessed by the deck group deckAut (GSR n) (S n) (UniversalCover.proj V v₀)

questions: « variété » (l.432) read connected, Hausdorff, second countable (plan F6); only Hausdorff is used (proper discontinuity and local compactness of V). Same reading as the marked § 3 / Theorem A rows (WP-45t/u/w/x).

« son revêtement universel » read as the universal cover at a base point v₀ (homotopy classes of paths from v₀) with the pulled-back projective structure; the choice of v₀ is immaterial up to isomorphism over a connected V, and every simply connected covering is certified too.

The paper gives no proof (running prose, p. 238); the formalized proof takes G₁ = the deck group. Its identification with π₁(V, v₀) is available only for the underlying homeomorphisms (UniversalCover.deckEquiv), not stated for deckAut.

kb_proposals: lean-benzecri has the universal cover (BenzecriScaffold.Port.UniversalCover, a mechanical port of lean-causal's Causal/Port/UniversalCover.lean at 82ee40f, itself gx's at e5a1d46): grep Benzecri.UniversalCover before porting it again.

Deck groups as automorphism groups: deckAut G X π (a Subgroup of GXAut) with properlyDiscontinuousSMul / isCancelSMul / compactSpace_quotient; isDivisible_of_isCoveringMap turns any simply connected covering of a compact Hausdorff (G,X)-manifold into a divisible one.

A manifold charted on S(n) or ℝⁿ is semilocally simply connected: semilocallySimplyConnected_of_proj / _aff (S.homeomorphEuclideanSphere + Mathlib's sphere charts, Mathlib.Geometry.Manifold.Instances.Sphere); Mathlib's isSimplyConnected_iff_exists_homotopy_refl_forall_mem turns a simply connected subset into null-homotopies of its loops.

Syntax pitfall: in `{ a := x, b := y,\n  c := z }` the continuation line must start at or right of the first field's column (sepByIndent), else 'unexpected identifier; expected }'; and `omit [...] in` goes BEFORE the docstring.
